mentions.name: Seaquel
mentions.description: A lightweight, fast database desktop client built with Tauri and SvelteKit. It is extensible via a plugin architecture in which the entire app is mostly plugins around a small core, and includes a small LLM integration for asking questions about the database or generating and reviewing queries.
